record.original_question: Let (e^{tA}) be a C0-semigroup on a Hilbert space H, where -A is associated with a form a: V x V -> H with form domain V contained in H, and let C be a closed convex subset of H. Characterize, in terms of a and V, when C is individually eventually invariant under the semigroup and when C is uniformly eventually invariant under the semigroup.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $H$ be a complex Hilbert space and let $V \hookrightarrow H$ be a densely and continuously embedded Hilbert space (the form domain). Let $a : V \times V \to \mathbb{C}$ be a densely defined, continuous, coercive (or, more generally, $j$-elliptic) sesquilinear form, and let $-A$ denote the operator on $H$ associated with $a$, so that $A$ generates a $C_0$-semigroup $(e^{tA})_{t \in [0, \infty)}$ on $H$. Let $C \subseteq H$ be a non-empty closed convex subset.

Say that $C$ is:
(a) individually eventually invariant under the semigroup if for every $x \in C$ there exists $t_0 = t_0(x) \ge 0$ such that $e^{tA} x \in C$ for all $t \ge t_0$;
(b) uniformly eventually invariant under the semigroup if there exists $t_0 \ge 0$ such that $e^{tA} x \in C$ for all $x \in C$ and all $t \ge t_0$.

Provide a characterization, expressed purely in terms of the form $a$ and the form domain $V$ (in the spirit of the Ouhabaz invariance criterion, which characterizes the everywhere-invariance property $e^{tA} C \subseteq C$ for all $t \ge 0$ via the orthogonal projection $P_C$ onto $C$ by the conditions $P_C V \subseteq V$ and $\operatorname{Re} a(P_C v, v - P_C v) \ge 0$ for all $v \in V$), of property (a) and/or property (b).
artifact.status_search_result: The problem appears in a recent open problems collection on positivity and eventual properties of operator semigroups. While the classical (instantaneous) invariance has the well-known Ouhabaz form characterization, and recent work has investigated eventual cone invariance for matrices and some semigroup settings, no form-theoretic characterization of individual or uniform eventual invariance of a general closed convex set under a form-induced $C_0$-semigroup on a Hilbert space appears in the literature. The problem is stated as open.

status_evidence.title: Eventual cone invariance revisited
status_evidence.snippet: Investigates eventual cone invariance properties of matrices and operators, indicating active recent research on eventual invariance but not providing a form-method characterization for general convex sets under form-induced semigroups.
status_evidence.claim: Recent research addresses eventual invariance, but no form-method characterization of eventual invariance of closed convex sets is established.

status_evidence.title: Invariance of closed convex sets and domination criteria for semigroups
status_evidence.snippet: Classical Ouhabaz-type characterizations of invariance of closed convex sets via sesquilinear forms, addressing only instantaneous (everywhere-in-time) invariance.
status_evidence.claim: The classical analogue addresses invariance for all $t\ge 0$, not eventual invariance.
